works.title: SSO login fails for SAML-configured users after recent update
works.body: Several enterprise users report being unable to log in via SAML SSO since yesterday's deployment. Error: 'Invalid assertion signature'.

works.title: MFA enforcement not applying to newly invited users
works.body: Admin-enforced MFA policy is being bypassed by users who accept invites and set up accounts for the first time.

works.title: Session timeout set to 24h not being respected
works.body: Users are being logged out after 1 hour despite the org-level timeout configured at 24 hours.

works.title: Monthly invoice not generated for Enterprise plan renewal
works.body: Invoice for June renewal was not issued. Customer is blocked on internal AP approval without the invoice PDF.

works.title: Valid credit card being declined on subscription renewal
works.body: Customer's credit card on file is valid and unexpired but the renewal charge is failing with a generic decline code.

works.title: Invoice PDF missing VAT number required for EU compliance
works.body: Invoices generated for EU customers do not include the vendor's VAT registration number, causing compliance issues.

works.title: Webhooks not firing for 'subscription.cancelled' event
works.body: Configured webhooks for the subscription.cancelled event are not being triggered. No delivery attempts shown in logs.

works.title: Webhook retry logic sending duplicate events after recovery
works.body: When the destination endpoint goes down and recovers, retried webhook payloads are being duplicated, causing double-processing.

works.title: API rate limit errors not returning Retry-After header
works.body: When rate-limited, the API returns HTTP 429 but omits the Retry-After header, breaking client back-off logic.

works.title: OAuth token expiry not communicated in integration dashboard
works.body: When a connected OAuth integration token expires, users receive no in-app notification and the integration silently fails.

works.title: Downgrade from Enterprise to Pro plan not reflected in UI
works.body: After a plan downgrade, the billing portal still shows Enterprise tier features and charges. No confirmation email sent.

works.title: SSO attribute mapping for 'department' field not saving
works.body: Custom attribute mapping for the 'department' SAML attribute does not persist after saving in the SSO configuration panel.

sla_policies.name: Lumio Enterprise SLA
sla_policies.description: Enterprise-tier SLA policy for Lumio's highest-value customers. Aggressive first-response and resolution targets with escalation on breach.
sla_policies.escalation: Page on-call engineer immediately for p0 breach; notify support manager for p1 breach after 1h.

ui_guidance.title: Create a 'Lumio Enterprise' saved view for p0/p1 tickets
steps: Navigate to Support → Views and click New View.
Set filters: Account ∈ {Acme Corp, Initech Financial, Globex Solutions} AND Priority ∈ {p0, p1} AND Status ≠ Closed.
Save as a Shared View and pin to the sidebar.
Use this view as the SLA breach demo entry point to show first-response countdown timers.

ui_guidance.title: Configure custom ticket stages for the Lumio support workflow
steps: Add two new stages: 'Waiting on Customer' (after In Progress) and 'Escalated to Engineering' (before Closed).
On 'Escalated to Engineering' entry, configure a stage transition action to create a linked Issue on the relevant Part.
Demo this flow using tic:sso-login-fail to show the ticket → issue traceability story.

ui_guidance.title: Automation: auto-label critical Authentication tickets
steps: Go to Settings → Automations → New Rule.
Trigger: Ticket Created. Condition: applies_to_part contains 'Authentication' AND priority IN (p0, p1).
Action 2: Assign to the Auth team queue.
Save and test by creating a mock p0 ticket under the Authentication capability.
